adjustments.reason: H-2 (external audit, pre-REL-004 fix): `http_date_to_unix` parsed the year as `i64` with NO range check (day/hour/minute/second all had one). With an absurd year the `era * 146_097` term in `days_from_civil` overflowed i64 — reproduced in-repo: `year = i64::MAX` → panic `attempt to multiply with overflow` at retry.rs:172 (debug), wrap-around in release. Fix: a 4-digit year bound (`1000..=9999`, per RFC 9110's `year = 4DIGIT`) returning `None`, plus saturating arithmetic as defence-in-depth. The bounded range is deliberate: silently degrading a malformed date to 0 would assert `retry immediately` — the same class of fabricated semantics as ERR-003. +82 wc -l measured standalone; this entry is the H-2 step of a two-step chain on this file (H-1 follows).

adjustments.reason: DELTA-NULL (post-0.1.5 bugfix, task DELTA-NULL): OpenAI-compatible endpoints legitimately send the TERMINAL stream frame as {"delta":null,"finish_reason":"stop",...} (official OpenAI semantics; also observed on llama.cpp, some vLLM builds and self-hosted proxies), and some upstreams omit the field entirely. CompStreamChoice declared `delta: CompDelta` (non-Option), so `delta:null` failed serde with `missing field `delta`` and parse_sse_line returned LlmError::Parse("failed to parse OpenAI-compatible stream chunk: missing field `delta`") for the whole stream => the caller surfaced "Invalid response" => every streamed tool-calling turn failed at the real tool call. Measured reproduction (downstream beeli vertical slice S3): endpoint http://127.0.0.1:18778/v1, both nous/meituan/longcat-2.5:free and nous/upstage/solar-mini4:free trigger it; terminal frame verbatim: {"choices":[{"delta":null,"index":0,"finish_reason":"stop","message":{"role":"assistant","content":"可用"},...}]}. Fix: `#[serde(default)] delta: Option<CompDelta>` + a single `empty_delta` placeholder bound at the top of the choices arm, so the three usage sites (tool_calls ingest, reasoning/reasoning_content, content) keep their logic unchanged. Growth is real fix + tests, not inflation: +56 wc -l measured (1843 -> 1899), of which the implementation is ~15 lines (struct doc + Option/default, the empty_delta binding, the three rewritten usage sites) and ~41 lines are three regression tests (null delta parses / absent delta parses / normal increment still parses).
